content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A degree from a recognised university. Nine years experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/ Commercial/ Govt. Undertaking. Experience: Nine years experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/ Commercial/ Govt. Undertaking. Age limit: Maximum 40 years Other conditions: Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply, through proper channel. Eligibility is determined as on the last date of receipt of the application, 28-11-2026. Desirable: Post Graduate degree/diploma in personnel management/industrial relations/social work/labour welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognised institution/university.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications without the requisite documents, received after 14-12-2026, will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The officer can opt for the pay fixed in the deputation post, or for the pay of the parent department plus deputation allowance. Deputation period is 3 years, extendable to 4 years. In exceptional circumstances it can be extended to 5 years.

rows.event: Last Date to Forward Applications by Ports

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certified Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) Statement showing year wise availability of APARs and grading Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualifications No objection certificate from the respective Port Undertaking of the applicant (Annexure-III) Vigilance and Administrative Clearance (Annexure-IV) Two latest passport size photographs Certificate by the employer (Annexure-V)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Circulate the vacancy among eligible officers and forward applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure - II). Superscribe the envelope with Application for the post of Deputy Secretary (Class-I). Send to the Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010. Make sure it reaches by 28 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Advance copy of application received by e-mail or post within the last date 28.11.2026 will be considered, additional time till 14.12.2026 will be given for forwarding applications with additional documents by the concerned port.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Secretary.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure - II) and send it to Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010, by post or by email, to reach by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree from a recognised university with 9 years experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply, through proper channel. Eligibility is determined as on the last date of receipt of the application, 28-11-2026.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications without the requisite documents, received after 14-12-2026, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Absorption/deputation method.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation period is 3 years, extendable to 4 years. In exceptional circumstances it can be extended to 5 years.
